brief.speaker: Sgt. Vale
brief.script: [quietly] Listen. The base is somewhere past that bend. [firmly] Find the relay mast. We'll follow its signal in.

contact.speaker: Pike
contact.script: [nervous] Vale? The ground's moving. [shouts] On our left!

loss.speaker: Sgt. Vale
loss.script: [shouts] Pike! Ellis! [shaky breath] Just us now. [urgent] Get those things off the trail.

clear.speaker: Sgt. Vale
clear.script: [relieved] I see the mast. Come on. [quietly] Let's get their names back to base.

recorder.speaker: Ellis
recorder.script: [curious] A survey beacon. Still blinking. Listen... that's a landing code.

bearing.speaker: Sgt. Vale
bearing.script: [quietly] I know that code. Freight crews used to land here. Follow the blue stakes.

nest.speaker: Pike
nest.script: [uneasy] Those aren't rocks. Look at the shells. Something broke out from the inside.

hatch.speaker: Ellis
hatch.script: [urgent] There! By the eggs! They're coming through!

flyby.speaker: Ellis
flyby.script: [excited] Look up! A Kestrel! She's flying low enough to read the hull.

chase.speaker: Sgt. Vale
chase.script: [urgent] She's heading for the base! After her! Pike, keep her in sight!

crossfire.speaker: Pike
crossfire.script: [startled] Wait! Something just crossed behind Ellis! [shouts] Both sides!

breather.speaker: Ellis
breather.script: [breathless] Four of us. Good. I lost the ship, but I see her landing lights past that notch.

gate.speaker: Pike
gate.script: [relieved] There. Two green lamps. That's the base gate. We made it.

confirm.speaker: You
confirm.script: [quietly] Copy, Vale. I’ll watch for the mast.

report.speaker: You
report.script: [somber] Base, this is Canyon Patrol. Two walking in. Put Pike and Ellis on the record.

lift_gate.speaker: Pike
lift_gate.script: [relieved] Two green lamps. That's a freight lift! Still has power.

lift_clear.speaker: Sgt. Vale
lift_clear.script: [quietly] Take the lift. We're getting out of this canyon, and we're taking their names with us.

lift_ride.speaker: You
lift_ride.script: [quietly] Going up. Stay with me, Vale.

surface_ship.speaker: Sgt. Vale
surface_ship.script: [surprised] Same ship. See the engine flare? She's heading across the flats. Let's follow.

first_pack.speaker: You
first_pack.script: [urgent] Spiders on the plain. They're coming right at us!

second_pack.speaker: Sgt. Vale
second_pack.script: [urgent] More of them! Off the ridge, on our right!

third_pack.speaker: You
third_pack.script: [tense] I see the station. One more pack between us and that dish.

shelter.speaker: Sgt. Vale
shelter.script: [breathless] A field station. Sit a minute. There's water under the bench and the radio still has power.

distress.speaker: You
distress.script: [steady] Survey station to base. Two survivors from Canyon Patrol. Request pickup. Do you copy?

rover_plan.speaker: Sgt. Vale
rover_plan.script: [quietly] Base always answers this channel. Something's wrong. That rover has a full cell. Let's go find out.

relay_arrival.speaker: Sgt. Vale
relay_arrival.script: [quietly] Leave the rover here. See the amber light under the dish? The repeater's still on battery.

relay_inspect.speaker: You
relay_inspect.script: [puzzled] Last call received. That's us, Vale. Our message got this far.

relay_reply.speaker: Sgt. Vale
relay_reply.script: [focused] Look at the breaker. The base feed tripped before we called. Follow those cable posts.

trench_contact.speaker: Sgt. Vale
trench_contact.script: [urgent] Under the cable tray! Back up, give yourself room!

trench_inspect.speaker: You
trench_inspect.script: [uneasy] The jacket's split from underneath. Egg cases in the copper. They came up through the power trench.

trench_reply.speaker: Sgt. Vale
trench_reply.script: [quietly] That took out the transmitter. But somebody laid these blue lamps. Look where they lead.

shelter_contact.speaker: You
shelter_contact.script: [urgent] Movement by the shelter! Keep them away from that hatch!

shelter_log.speaker: Mara Sen
shelter_log.script: [strained] Shift log, Mara Sen. We lost power in the east gallery. Kestrel took the injured. Everyone else, down to Shelter Two. Seal behind me.

shelter_reply.speaker: Sgt. Vale
shelter_reply.script: [softly] The ship we chased was an ambulance. Try the hardline. It runs straight through that door.

hardline_call.speaker: You
hardline_call.script: [carefully] Shelter Two, this is Canyon Patrol. Vale and I are outside. Is anyone there?

hardline_answer.speaker: Mara Sen
hardline_answer.script: [relieved] Patrol? Oh, thank God. Twelve of us down here. We heard your boots on the hatch.

hardline_vale.speaker: Sgt. Vale
hardline_vale.script: [gently] Twelve. Copy that, Mara. Keep the door sealed. We're staying right here.

hold_one.speaker: Sgt. Vale
hold_one.script: [firmly] Hatch is sealed. I've brought the sentry online. First pack coming up the middle. Hold them here.

hold_two.speaker: You
hold_two.script: [breathless] Center lane's clear. Dust on the west approach. Vale, swing left with me.

hold_three.speaker: Mara Sen
hold_three.script: [tense] We feel them through the floor again. East side this time. Is the pad still yours?

hold_four.speaker: Sgt. Vale
hold_four.script: [reassuring] It's ours, Mara. Kestrel has your head count. Both approaches now. Reload while you can.

hold_five.speaker: Kestrel pilot
hold_five.script: [steady] Patrol, I see your beacon. One last swarm crossing the lights. Clear me a place to land.

hold_landing.speaker: Sgt. Vale
hold_landing.script: [relieved] Perimeter clear. Bring her down, Kestrel. Mara, you can open that hatch now.

hold_salute.speaker: Kestrel pilot
hold_salute.script: [warmly] Twelve seats ready. Good to see you two still standing. We'll take it from here.

west_reply.speaker: Sgt. Vale
west_reply.script: [focused] I've got the gap by the wall. Leave the stragglers to me.

east_reply.speaker: You
east_reply.script: [reassuring] Still ours, Mara. Stay on the line. I'll tell you when it's safe.

pad_reply.speaker: You
pad_reply.script: [steady] Fresh belt in. I can see the landing lights from here.

final_reply.speaker: Sgt. Vale
final_reply.script: [firmly] Copy, Kestrel. Keep your wheels up until you hear my voice.

drive_start.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_start.script: There's our first ping. Straight ahead. Keep her steady till we get a second bearing.

drive_left.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_left.script: Got the next one. Turn left here. I'll keep an eye on the scope.

drive_right.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_right.script: Contact on your right. Take us round that shoulder.

drive_bear_left.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_bear_left.script: There. Bear left a little. Signal's coming up over the ridge.

drive_bear_right.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_bear_right.script: I've got it. Ease right. That's our way through.

drive_ahead.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_ahead.script: Next signal's dead ahead. Hold this course.

drive_back.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_back.script: Behind us. Bring her around till the diamond's at the top.

drive_fault.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_fault.script: Hold up. Five's transmitting its own tag, but it isn't passing the next bearing. Park here. We'll open the cabinet.

drive_panel.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_panel.script: Look at the amber socket. The cartridge shook loose. I'll steady the aerial. Push it back in.

drive_test.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_test.script: Hold it there. I'm sending a test pulse.

drive_fixed.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_fixed.script: Green light. There's the return ping. Back to the rover, I'll read you the turn.

fork_watch.speaker: Pike
fork_watch.script: I'll watch the high fork. Ellis, you've got both hands free.

fork_tune.speaker: Ellis
fork_tune.script: Here. Turn my receiver. That chirp gets quicker when you're pointing at the ship. Hold the bearing and mark it.

fork_keep.speaker: Ellis
fork_keep.script: That's her. Keep the receiver on your belt. I'll read the stakes.

flats_fork.speaker: Sgt. Vale
flats_fork.script: Amber poles take the high ridge. We'll see her from there. Blue poles drop into the wash. Survey crews cache supplies down there. Your call.

flats_ridge.speaker: Sgt. Vale
flats_ridge.script: There she is again. Follow that engine flare along the ridge.

flats_wash.speaker: Sgt. Vale
flats_wash.script: Lost her behind the bank. Take what's in the cache. See those blue lamps? They come out under her flight path.

drive_align.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_align.script: I'll climb up to the feed. You rotate the receiver below. When I get a strong reading, lock it there.

drive_strong.speaker: Sgt. Vale
drive_strong.script: That's coming up. A little further. Hold it there!

drive_fragment.speaker: Mara Sen
drive_fragment.script: Shelter Two calling. We have twelve…

power_reason.speaker: Mara Sen
power_reason.script: Kestrel can't see the pad. We had a battery trailer out at the maintenance yard. I can talk you there.

tow_begin.speaker: Mara Sen
tow_begin.script: Take the service track out of the shelter. At the relay bend, follow the poles downhill to the yellow trailer.

tow_yard.speaker: Mara Sen
tow_yard.script: Pass the old array and bear toward the yard beacon. The battery's on wheels. Bring the rover alongside the drawbar.

tow_hook.speaker: Sgt. Vale
tow_hook.script: Pin's in. Give the trailer room on the bends. I'll take the gun.

tow_home.speaker: Mara Sen
tow_home.script: I can hear the engine now. Bring the battery to the pad junction. I'll open the feed.

circuit_pick.speaker: Sgt. Vale
circuit_pick.script: One live feed. Sentry or approach lights first, your call. I'll cover the junction.

circuit_two.speaker: Mara Sen
circuit_two.script: The second bank is charged. Close the other circuit while Vale covers you.

circuit_last.speaker: Sgt. Vale
circuit_last.script: Last row's still dark. Take the far switch. I'll watch the gap.

names_log.speaker: Sgt. Vale
names_log.script: Put two more names in your log.

crew_count.speaker: Kestrel pilot
crew_count.script: [warmly] Twelve survivors accounted for. I've got every name, Sergeant. Good to see you two.
